source.title: The Northern Herald, 14 January 1933, p. 2 ("Bangor Ratepayers' Association. Municipal Election")
source.publisher: The Northern Herald (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Borough elections, 16 January 1933. Ballyholme was the only contest; the other four wards returned members unopposed. Returned unopposed; named in the Ratepayers' Association address for the Castle, Clifton and Dufferin wards. Ward assignment follows the seat each held at the 1931 election. Returned unopposed.
